title: Short-Term Rental of State land and properties
summary: State land and properties are rented for short-term uses through Temporary Occupation Licences (TOLs); vacant State properties can be rented for events for not more than 90 days, applied for online. The page does not state a lead time or processing time.

title: Licence for the Provision of Arts Entertainment
summary: IMDA's licence page for arts entertainment (sections: who it is for, exemptions, fees, how to apply). Page body could not be read by our tool; details taken from IMDA's submission guidelines below.

title: Submission Guidelines for Arts Entertainment Licence Applications (wef 6 Feb 2024)
summary: Applications should be made at least 40 working days before the event; IMDA processes within 20 working days of complete information. Some arts entertainment is exempt from licensing, subject to conditions.

title: Public Entertainment or Arts Entertainment activities exempted from licence
summary: Lists entertainment activities that need no licence if the exemption conditions are met; some exempt activities still require the organiser to notify the Police at least 7 days before. Events that do not meet the conditions must apply for an Arts Entertainment Licence from IMDA.

title: Booking rates for void decks and open spaces
summary: Residents of the town can book void decks and open spaces with a Town Council permit, up to 6 months ahead, first come first served. Variety shows are not permitted at void decks but are listed for open spaces; other Town Councils set their own rules.

title: Apply for an organised group activity permit
summary: Group activities of more than 30 people in the nature park networks and Rail Corridor need a permit applied for at least 1 month ahead (2 months for Pulau Ubin); late applications are rejected. It does not cover general events in town or regional parks.

title: Usage of Premises in Parks
summary: Search listing says using park premises for an event needs NParks approval. The page itself returned 403 to our tool, so this is not verified line by line.

title: Lively Places Fund
summary: Funds non-commercial projects that activate public spaces: up to $5,000 for activations of 6 months or less, up to $20,000 for longer ones; artist fees can be supported with NAC. Singapore Citizens/PRs apply as individuals or teams; the space must stay publicly accessible; projects already funded by other agencies are not eligible.

title: Lively Places Fund and Challenge (HDB estates)
summary: HDB's page for the same programme in HDB towns. Page returned 404 to our tool; search snippets mention a community match, so treat HDB-specific terms as unverified.

title: Presentation and Participation Grant
summary: NAC grant for performances, exhibitions and festivals; search snippets of this page cite a cap of $100,000 per applicant per financial year and fixed application cycles. The page returned 404 to our tool, so criteria are assumptions.

title: WeCare Arts Fund — overview and guidelines (3 Apr 2023)
summary: Search snippets of this guide mention support of up to $5,000 per project and that projects already started are excluded. The PDF returned 404 to our tool, so all criteria are assumptions.

title: OurSG Grants portal
summary: Government portal listing arts, community, heritage, youth and sports grants; the place to check current grant cycles.
